title: calamagrostis purpurascens subsp. arctica
intro: Calamagrostis purpurascens subsp. arctica, commonly known as Arctic Fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to support respiratory health, and has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including bronchitis, coughs, and colds. The therapeutic actions of Calamagrostis purpurascens subsp. arctica include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
